name: Haruna Nozomu
source:
A young man who is on a sight-seeing trip to Koukashi. When he has spare time, he comes calling at Tsuki no Hotori, immersing the protagonist in seductions for his own self-satisfaction. He doesn't like talking about himself much and seems to hold many secrets.

[From [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2013/04/17/getsuei-no-kusari/]Otome Jikan[/url]]
